test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

STIFF
solution:
The correct answer is **'Tender'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's see the meaning of the word "**Stiff" **and other words given in the options.
 
• Stiff- rigid or firm; difficult or impossible to bend or flex
 
 
• E.g.- The furniture was stiff, uncomfortable, too delicate, and too neat
 
 
 
• Tender- weak or delicate in constitution; not strong or hardy
 
 
• E.g.- Her voice was tender, full of pity
 
 

So the correct answer is Tender

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Strong(adj) **physically powerful; able to lift or carry heavy things.
 
• **Rigid (adj): **unable to bend or be forced out of shape; not flexible.
 
• **Tight(Adj) **fixed firmly in position and difficult to move or remove.
